sources: Quaternius, Ultimate Animated Animal Pack: Stag.gltf (from https://pixeltriks.com). https://quaternius.com/packs/ultimateanimatedanimals.html CC0 1.0 (public domain): https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
A red deer stag: about 1.22 m at the shoulder, a reddish-brown coat in summer, a light rump, large antlers.

Red deer stags in Scotland average 201 cm in head-and-body length and 122 cm high at the shoulder; reddish-brown in their summer coats; antlers typically 71 cm in total length (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Red_deer).
The colors: from a photo of a red deer stag in summer (https://www.inaturalist.org/observations/16696749).
The lengths of the fur (fur): a guess from photos of the animal, not a measurement.
